001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.scopedkeyvalues.provider;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor;
005import io.jstach.rainbowgum.scopedkeyvalues.ScopedKeyValues;
006import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider;
007import io.jstach.svc.ServiceProvider;
008
009/**
010 * Registers {@link ScopedKeyValues} as a {@link KeyValuesContributor} for
011 * {@link KeyValuesContributor.Source.Standard#SCOPED_KEY_VALUES}, so every logging API
012 * Rainbow Gum supports picks up the current scoped key values. Simply having this module
013 * on the classpath is enough: no configuration, no properties.
014 */
015@ServiceProvider(RainbowGumServiceProvider.class)
016public final class ScopedKeyValuesConfigurator implements RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator {
017
018        /**
019         * For service loader.
020         */
021        public ScopedKeyValuesConfigurator() {
022        }
023
024        @Override
025        public boolean configure(@SuppressWarnings("exports") LogConfig config, @SuppressWarnings("exports") Pass pass) {
026                KeyValuesContributor.register(config.serviceRegistry(), KeyValuesContributor.Source.Standard.SCOPED_KEY_VALUES,
027                                ScopedKeyValuesContributor.INSTANCE);
028                return true;
029        }
030
031}
